sayWin: [d113] A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
[d113] Blaise came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
[d113] Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
[d113] Back at the haven the argument starts: Blaise is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

[d116] ◈ "UNIT TRAIL COMPASS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; harder to get truly lost. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d116] ◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.
[d116] 📖 The memory leaves something behind: North is north. You can find it.
[d116] 💛 The Trail compass is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)

[d116] ◈ "UNIT SEED PACKET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d116] ◈ FLASHBACK — Seed packet
Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.
[d116] 📖 The memory leaves something behind: You know what grows. You will prove it.
[d116] 💛 The Seed packet is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
